about.metaDescription: AGRO IBO is a domestic company founded in Kyrgyzstan. HYDROWOOLKS next-generation organic fertilizers.
about.badge: A Kyrgyz company with international goals
about.subtitle: ibo is a domestic company founded in Kyrgyzstan. Our goal is to increase crop yields and preserve soil fertility with high-quality, ecologically safe organic solutions.

bottle.name: HYDROWOOLKS
bottle.note: Liquid organic fertilizer based on hydrolyzed sheep wool

company.title: What ibo does
company.description: The company creates practical solutions for farmers and helps adopt modern eco-friendly growing methods.
points: Product export within Kyrgyzstan and abroad.
Support for the development of organic farming.

product.title: Our flagship product
product.description: HYDROWOOLKS is a liquid organic fertilizer obtained through a special hydrolysis of sheep wool. It is produced in Kyrgyzstan and suitable for many types of crops.
